properties.site-address: Garage site, entrance adjacent to 35 Armson Road, Bedworth
properties.notes: Formerly Council owned garages in a residential area. Application for 13 dwellings Ref 032092 was refused on 6/11/2013. Site assessed as being deliverable in the SHLAA 2016. Allocated as a proposed Non-strategic site in the Borough Plan 2011-2031 Publication (2017)
